prompt:
Perform the final hostile review of the corrected R3 ViceSharp requirements-recovery and VICE-realignment plan. Execute the complete add-profile skill first. Read the R1 and R2 response receipts. This is read-only planning. Do not modify product code, requirements, TODO state, existing plans, or generated docs. You may create only the response JSONL and dedicated MCP Session Log.

Evidence baseline:
- d28493a has 144 canonical requirements, 108 FR/17 TR/19 TEST. 114 IDs are globally absent live; 115 are absent at the required same type.
- Current active canonical has 206 explicit ID definitions, 129 FR/36 TR/41 TEST. 125 IDs are globally absent live; 126 are absent at the required same type.
- The active 206 excludes retired heading-only FR-XBOXGPL-007 and includes non-ID-heading definitions FR-WARP-001, TR-HOST-PRG-001, TR-WARP-STATUS-001.
- Live MCP has 383 typed records, 381 unique IDs, 293 zero-AC records, 25 unmapped FRs, two cross-type duplicates TEST-DRV-001 and TEST-UI-001, and wrong-type-only TEST-VIC-001 stored as a TR placeholder. Its 115 FR mapping groups contain 155 TR and 152 TEST edges, 307 total, with all named references resolving.
- The generated May export is proven incomplete/collapsed. Whether its cause was an incomplete pre-export DB or exporter defect is UNKNOWN. No ID-reuse rationale was found in searched Git/TODO/session audits, but universal absence is UNKNOWN.
- PLAN-REQAUDIT-001 remains the program umbrella and already requires full FR/TR/TEST audit, VICE-derived ACs verified by running VICE, BDPv4 red-first TDD, 100 percent green, and VICE as specification including VICE bugs.

Hard source and scope rules:
1. Latest explicit owner direction controls scope and intentional divergence.
2. Pinned pristine VICE source/executable behavior is the compatibility contract, including VICE bugs.
3. Original and pre-collapse Git canonical text supplies recoverable unchanged behavior contracts.
4. Approved later canonical additions/refinements are preserved field by field.
5. MCP audit supplies chronology/provenance; live records and generated exports are reconciliation evidence, not automatic replacement authority.
6. Hardware captures and authoritative datasheets may reveal discrepancies, but cannot silently override VICE. Any intentional managed divergence requires a distinct observable-behavior FR and explicit owner approval.
7. UWP/Xbox is retired from active scope through approved scope layers, never erased. uIEC remains general unless an approved FR says otherwise.
8. Managed ViceSharp is the system under test.

Decision-complete plan:

Phase 0, immutable preflight and oracle proof.
- Snapshot and hash raw plus effective product/local requirements, all layer metadata, mappings, TODO/session audits, canonical files, current Git SHA and dirty inventory, native VICE submodule SHA, local patch manifest, pristine and shim binary hashes, ROM hashes, resolver-loaded DLL hashes, machine profiles, media/workload inputs, and extraction rules plus exact ID lists.
- Build pristine pinned upstream x64sc/xvic and patched shim variants. Inventory every semantic patch and run trace-equivalence probes on all compared behavior. Reject the oracle if instrumentation changes behavior.
- Define active/retired from approved scope layers. No requirements generate/ingest/write occurs.

Phase 1, per-ID and per-field recovery ledger.
- Union d1f7175, d28493a, current canonical, raw/effective live MCP, layer metadata, TODO audits, and session audits.
- For every ID, independently decide type, title, body, each acceptance criterion, priority, status, scope-start/scope-end layer, and every mapping edge using the source rules.
- Classify each field restore, merge, re-ID, retire, or owner-decision with commit/path/line/audit provenance and reason.
- Flag placeholders, malformed IDs, wrong-type records, cross-type duplicates, ambiguous status, narrowed foundational contracts, and live-only additions. Never automatically delete live-only content.

Phase 2, owner-approved atomic restoration.
- Before any write, produce a staged full-set preview and exact normalized before/after diff for every field and edge. Owner approves that artifact.
- Invariants: expected counts by type and layer, ID plus type uniqueness, valid references, no placeholder bodies, required AC and mapping coverage, exact scope, maximum unexpected deletions zero, and an explicit expected-change allowlist.
- Apply only supported MCP helpers at a defined commit boundary. Stop on the first mismatch. Use a hashed compensating inverse manifest to restore the complete preflight state automatically, then verify restoration field by field. If supported helpers cannot prove full rollback, do not mutate and require a separate MCP Server capability change outside this repo.
- Restore all approved active requirements, including broad FR-CPU-002, FR-VIC-001 through 010, TR-CYCLE-001, current VIC-20 behavior FRs, and properly typed TEST-VIC-001. Move narrow checkpoint text to AC/TR/TEST. Preserve legitimate later records. Set unproved behavior pending. Retire Xbox/UWP via layers without deleting history.

Phase 3, requirements and traceability gate.
- Every active observable behavior is FR with concrete structured ACs. Every active FR maps to at least one appropriate TR and TEST; every AC maps to executable test plus pinned VICE source/capture anchor.
- Resolve every zero-AC, unmapped active FR, invalid edge, duplicate/wrong-type ID, placeholder, and absent referenced ID by approved merge/re-ID/retire/completion.
- Observable settings visibility stays FR-UISETVIS-001. Architecture belongs in TR, executable differential proof in TEST.
- Hostile requirements review must return AGREE at accuracy and completeness at least 98 before code work.

Phase 4, divergence ledger and exact implementation order.
- Revalidate all 47 PLAN-VICEPARITY-001 findings and the 2026-09-28 CPU audit against current HEAD.
- For every subsystem map pinned VICE entry points to managed entry points, FR/AC, observable state, red differential test, divergence, dependency, owner, and completion receipt.
- Mandatory order, with documented/approved exceptions only: oracle/harness; clock/bus/PLA/memory; CPU micro-ops/interrupts/steals; C64 and VIC-20 machine glue; VIC-II/VIC-I; CIA/VIA/IEC/input; SID/audio; storage/tape/cartridge/media; reset/snapshot/determinism/pacing; UI.
- Each BDPv4 slice gates approved requirement and hostile AGREE, failing test and hostile AGREE, smallest implementation, focused/dependent/full green, deterministic rerun, and hostile implementation AGREE.
- If current audit is reconfirmed, replace the CPU hybrid dual path with one VICE-macro-derived per-cycle micro-op engine covering all 256 opcodes, interrupt entry, decimal behavior, JAM, dummy accesses, steals, and serialized in-flight state.

Phase 5, versioned fail-closed lockstep proof.
- Define schema vice-lockstep/v1. Header contains schema version, VICE/shim/DLL/ROM hashes, profile, timing standard, workload/media/input hashes, seed, and normalization version.
- Each half-cycle event records sequence, PHI phase, bus owner, address/data/read-write/dummy access, BA/AEC, CPU registers/opcode/microstep/IRQ/NMI/JAM, VIC raster/cycle/VC/RC/badline/DMA/sprites, CIA/VIA timers/flags/pins, IEC/drive state, memory writes/checkpoint hash, audio sample/hash, and snapshot marker. Document normalization and comparison cadence.
- Retain deterministic replay inputs, periodic full snapshots, a first-divergence JSONL with context, and binary-search minimization to the earliest divergent event.
- A required Nuke/CI target fails on missing/wrong native DLL, ROM, environment, profile, media, workload, call, schema field, skip, pending, timeout, or silent return.
- Matrix covers xvic and x64sc regressions; PAL/NTSC; cold and reset paths; READY; keyboard, joystick, RESTORE; disk/1540, tape, cartridges and RAM configurations; snapshot resume; framebuffer; deterministic PCM; representative VICE/Lorenz and real workloads. Every case runs at least two seconds, PAL/NTSC baseline every-cycle gates run ten seconds, and named long soaks run beyond that. Required scope has zero skips/pending.
- Repair process isolation, xvic WriteSnapshot hang, and hosted C64 BA instrumentation before accepting proof.

Phase 6, VIC-20 settings behavior.
- Carry authoritative SettingsProfileDto.Machine family metadata into MachineProfileOption. Derive IsVic20Selected from family metadata, not labels.
- Raise PropertyChanged for IsVic20Selected on direct selection, profile refresh/repopulation, and settings restore.
- Red tests prove C64 to VIC-20 to C64 notification, immediate effective Avalonia visibility, hidden-control non-focusability, and VIC-20 draft preservation. Live RemoteControl/visual-tree proof complements view-model tests. uIEC stays general. No UWP/Xbox code or gate.

Phase 7, publication and completion.
- Generate docs only after approved MCP reconciliation.
- Compare post-generation normalized ledger field by field against the approved input for ID/type, title, body, each AC, priority, status, scope layers, and every mapping edge. Abort and automatically restore on deletion, narrowing, wrong-type move, or any non-allowlisted mutation.
- Run traceability, focused gates, full solution/TestHarness, deterministic reruns, complete native matrix, UI behavior, and final hostile review with zero required failures/skips. Only then propose a scoped commit/push to origin, after explicit approval.

Verify all evidence, phase ordering, rollback, fail-closed semantics, settings contract, and completion gates. Verdict must be AGREE or DISAGREE. AGREE requires accuracyScore and completenessScore both at least 98. Include PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN findings, exact anchors/commands, and persistence proof. Write one valid JSONL object to F:\GitHub\vice-sharp\docs\receipts\hv\20260928T192900Z-requirements-recovery-realignment-plan-r3.response.jsonl. Create and complete a dedicated MCP Session Log turn containing the entire substantive verdict, then query it back.
